evidence.locator: The sq031 striptease phase exits through reward248, node252, then positive sq031_cool_metal_fire_done writer251. This is the completed night handover, not an early scene start.

The Rogue scene writes q103_rogue_paid_up at node2861 after the payment choice; its completed main scene exits to q103_rogue_done writer157 in the Afterlife phase, after Rogue provides the Kang Tao route and names Panam. Both positive facts are required.

Tattoo choice section265 writes positive sq031_goat_tattoo at node273 and grants Items.CasiusTattoo at node678. Installed English localization names that exact item “Tattoo: Johnny’s Special.” The fact records the choice even if the inventory item is later removed.

The opposite tattoo choice section268 writes positive sq031_property_tattoo at node274 and grants Items.SilverhandTattoo at node679. Installed English localization names that exact item “Tattoo: Together Forever.” The choice fact is independent of later inventory changes.

The motel arrival entry305 cannot reach positive sq031_rogue_met_johnny writer806 without traversing section740 (blocked-node reach test false). Section740 states Johnny got the Grayson tip from Ruby and names Ebunike. Writer806 follows the completed motel discussion, so this is a sufficient persisted receipt for obtaining that lead.
The movie scene writes positive sq031_rogue_date_met after Rogue and V meet at the theater. This proves the outing was arranged and reached, without inferring any later intimacy.

Kerry addresses Johnny by name during the villa encounter (section919, line7425), then the encounter advances through the reunion discussion. Completion of sq011_kerry at node2716 is the positive reached-stage receipt, not the earlier sq011_kerry_met fact.

The villa scene includes the Samurai reunion proposal (section1053 line14593 and section1091 line17665). The completed sq011_kerry quest is downstream of those mandatory discussion stages; it does not imply the concert already happened.
The highway scene activates set_fire at node529 and resolves the same objective at node1179 before Kerry and V flee; succeeded is a positive stage receipt for the equipment sabotage.
The Nancy-saved scene has the ride-to-News-54 and post-ride talk stages, then resolves the 04_nancy quest phase at node617 before Second Conflict advances. Succeeded is a positive extraction receipt.

The Family Heirloom open-world phase activates the deliver_bootleg objective at node150 and sends its Succeeded input at node152 after node248. This is a positive delivery receipt for Dan’s recording.
The car-delivery branch of the Family Heirloom phase writes exact hil_06_deliver_car=1 at node223 before Rogue’s perfect debrief path. This is a positive branch receipt.
The separate branch writes exact hil_06_not_deliver_car=1 at node59 and continues to Rogue’s not-perfect debrief. No inference from a missing delivery fact is used.
The Psychofan phase waits for positive sts_hey_gle_03_guitar, then drives the drop objective’s Succeeded input at node40 and the quest success node41. The same phase tests the Kerry guitar item.

The mq023 vendor phase takes V to Karim’s street-vendor scene, resolves the Buck Ravers quest as Succeeded at node8, gives the quest reward, and writes exact mq023_done=1 at node10. This is a visit receipt, not a claim about optional purchases.

The nonlethal delivery branch writes spr_06_non_lethal and activates Rogue’s debrief_non_lethal phone message. Installed English text confirms the package was received. The active message is a positive Rogue-awareness receipt for this branch.

expected./femaleVariant: Package received. Thank you, V. Keep up the good work. The streets will remember your name.

evidence.locator: The lethal branch writes spr_06_rebeca_dead and activates Rogue’s debrief_kill phone message. Its installed English text treats the job as closed with a sacrifice. The active message is a positive debrief receipt.

expected./femaleVariant: Excellent. Sometimes equilibrium demands sacrifices. Contract closed.

evidence.locator: The Union Strikes Back subdued/no-casualties debrief is activated for Rogue at node181. Its installed English text says Vega is alive in the trunk and no civilians were hit. This is a narrow positive subset of the alive-delivery outcome.
The Union Strikes Back killed/no-casualties debrief is activated at node179. Its installed English text says Vega was flatlined. This is a narrow positive subset of the killed outcome.

The killed/no-casualties debrief is activated at node179 and its installed English text explicitly says Vega is flatlined and no one else is. It proves this no-other-kills subset without treating an absent casualty fact as zero.

The Nasty Hangover final phase routes the no-Karl-death branch to Rogue’s debrief_optional message at node52. Installed English text explicitly says Karl is still breathing and Rogue will arrange his safehouse. The active message is positive proof; a zero death fact is not queried.

The Nasty Hangover combat path writes exact arr_06_karl_killed=1 at node584. Its final debrief condition routes that positive state to Rogue’s debrief_non_optional message at node51. Both the death flag and active debrief are required.

The Nasty Hangover phase tests V’s Kang Tao credchip at node127, removes that chip at node128, grants 2,000 eddies at node129, then writes positive arr_06_v_took_money=1 at node126. The fact proves V cashed the payment, not merely found the offer.

The sq011_07a_royce encounter scene writes positive sq011_royce_stealth_path at node1509. The Nancy questphase routes into that scene on the branch where its preceding Pickup-outcome OR condition is false. This is a sufficient Royce-controlled encounter subset.

rules.statement: Johnny used V’s body for the night and handed control back after the outing.
V paid Rogue, who supplied the Hellman lead and directed V to Panam.
Johnny selected the tattoo named “Johnny’s Special” during his night using V’s body.
Johnny selected the tattoo named “Together Forever” during his night using V’s body.
Johnny gained the Ebunike lead through Ruby and V later relayed it to Rogue.
V arranged Johnny’s outing with Rogue; the pair subsequently met at the theater.
At Kerry’s villa, Kerry recognized Johnny speaking through V.
Johnny proposed bringing Samurai back during the meeting with Kerry; the performance had not happened yet.
V and Kerry completed the planned equipment sabotage.
V safely extracted Nancy from the Totentanz encounter.
V delivered Dan’s recording for Nancy’s Family Heirloom job.
V returned Dan’s car during Family Heirloom.
V completed the Family Heirloom branch without returning Dan’s car.
V delivered Kerry’s stolen guitar to the gig’s drop point.
V and Johnny completed the visit to Karim’s Samurai bootleg stall.
Rebeca Price was delivered alive, and Rogue acknowledged receiving her.
Rebeca Price was killed, and Rogue acknowledged the lethal result.
Vic Vega was delivered alive in the car for Rogue.
Vic Vega was killed, and Rogue received the lethal debrief.
The gig’s debrief confirms that Vega died and nobody else was killed.
Karl Ginsky survived and Rogue arranged a safehouse for him.
Karl Ginsky was killed during Nasty Hangover, and Rogue received the debrief.
V cashed Kang Tao’s credchip and received the payment.
Royce’s group controlled the Totentanz encounter that V navigated with Nancy.
